items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Ziegfeld Follies' and 'Florenz Ziegfeld' only in the context of the interviewer's question and general historical narration about the era, without stating any personal interaction or relationship.

ctx.x: know. But at that time, then, see, I don't know, I mean. He didn't live too long. George M. Cohan didn't live too long after that, I think. He passed.

Wouldn't you say at that time that most people that were on Broadway, you had to be multi-talented? men and women The standard of the shows was so good, so high, usually they had to dance well, sing, be able to be -- it was really the great era of great revues, great shows. Ziegfeld.
You must remember now, in those times America was overcoming the stock market crash. See? They was trying to -- they was in the process of overcoming that.
